title: Model
description: A part of a function that is chosen separately from the function's own parameters, with parameter sets of its own under instances/<role>/: e.g. the spatial correlation of a hazard field, which a function names as its `correlation_model` and a binding chooses with `correlation`. A model makes no BN node.

role.description: The role of the functions that use it; its parameter sets are filed under instances/<role>/.

instance_schema.description: JSON Schema every parameter set of this model must satisfy.
